basic_info.description: First time on the market in over 75 years! Nestled in the heart of San Francisco's prestigious & historic Russian Hill neighborhood & located on a beautiful & elegant tree lined block, 1162-1164 Vallejo Street presents a rare opportunity to own a classic Edwardian multi-family residence that blends vintage charm w/ urban convenience. Built in 1917 w/ timeless architectural character, this beautiful two-unit building, delivered vacant, spans approx. *2,890 bldg sf across 15 rooms & sits on a 3,436 sf lot offering generous light filled living areas & spacious outdoor patio & landscaped garden for relaxation/entertainment. A great income producing property located in the highly desirable RH-3 zoning district. Three large (unwarranted) bonus rooms w/ high ceilings on 1st level.  New gas stove & W/D in Unit 1164. Split bathrooms on all 3 levels. Large (2) car tandem garage. Walk to North Beach, Chinatown, Polk St & Fin District. Short stroll to gourmet restaurants, cafes, shops, grocery stores & just 1 block to the historic Hyde St cable cars. Walk Score of 96! "A Walkers Paradise!" Buyer to independently confirm actual bldg sf & current market rents and to check w/ City & County of San Francisco re: any potential condominium conversion or ADU addition.
